INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Independent Contractor Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 15, 2026, by and between Apex Digital Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Client"), and the undersigned independent contractor ("Contractor").

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Client is in the business of providing marketing technology solutions to enterprise customers; and

WHEREAS, Contractor possesses certain skills and expertise that Client desires to engage for the performance of services described herein;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth below, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES

1.1 Contractor shall perform such services as Client may reasonably request from time to time in connection with Client's marketing technology platform, including but not limited to front-end development, user interface design, API integrations, and related technical work (collectively, the "Services").

1.2 Contractor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

1.3 Contractor shall devote such time and attention to the Services as Client may reasonably require to complete the work in a timely fashion.

2. TERM

2.1 This Agreement shall commence on the date first written above and shall continue until terminated by either party in accordance with Section 9 below.

3. COMPENSATION AND PAYMENT

3.1 Client shall pay Contractor at the rate of $85.00 per hour for Services rendered pursuant to this Agreement.

3.2 Contractor shall submit detailed invoices on a monthly basis, including a description of Services performed, hours worked, and any pre-approved expenses.

3.3 All invoices shall be payable within ninety (90) calendar days following Client's receipt and acceptance of a properly submitted invoice. Client reserves the right to dispute any invoice or portion thereof, in which case payment of the disputed amount shall be withheld pending resolution. No interest, late fees, or penalties of any kind shall accrue on outstanding balances regardless of the duration of non-payment.

3.4 Contractor acknowledges that the payment schedule described herein reflects the Client's standard accounts payable cycle and agrees that no acceleration of payment may be requested.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

4.1 All work product, deliverables, materials, inventions, discoveries, improvements, designs, code, documentation, and creative works of any kind, whether or not patentable or copyrightable, that are conceived, created, developed, or reduced to practice by Contractor at any time during the term of this Agreement, including work created prior to the effective date of this Agreement and work created outside the scope of the Services described herein, shall be considered works made for hire and shall be the sole and exclusive property of Client. To the extent that any such work product does not qualify as a work made for hire, Contractor hereby irrevocably assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in and to such work product, including all intellectual property rights therein.

4.2 Contractor agrees that Client shall have the unrestricted right to use, modify, distribute, license, sublicense, and otherwise exploit all work product without any further compensation to Contractor.

4.3 Contractor shall not use any work product for any purpose, including portfolio display, without the prior written consent of Client.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Contractor shall hold in strict confidence all proprietary information, trade secrets, business plans, customer lists, pricing data, technical specifications, and other confidential information of Client disclosed during the course of this Agreement ("Confidential Information").

5.2 Contractor shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of Client.

5.3 The obligations of confidentiality shall survive the termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years.

6. NON-COMPETITION

6.1 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following its termination for any reason, Contractor shall not directly or indirectly engage in, own, manage, operate, consult for, be employed by, or participate in any business that is in the same industry as Client or that competes with any product, service, or line of business offered by Client or under development by Client at the time of termination. This restriction applies worldwide and covers all forms of professional engagement, whether as an employee, independent contractor, advisor, or in any other capacity.

6.2 Contractor acknowledges that the restrictions contained in this Section 6 are reasonable and necessary to protect Client's legitimate business interests and that any violation would cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy.

7. INDEMNIFICATION

7.1 Contractor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Client, its officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors, and assigns from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of or relating to the performance of the Services, any breach of this Agreement by Contractor, any negligent or wrongful act or omission of Contractor, and any claim by a third party relating to Client's use of the work product, including claims arising from circumstances beyond Contractor's knowledge or control.

7.2 Contractor's indemnification obligations under this Section 7 shall not be subject to any limitation of liability and shall survive the termination of this Agreement indefinitely.

8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination, or validity thereof, shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association in accordance with its Commercial Arbitration Rules. The arbitration shall take place in New York, New York, and shall be conducted by a single arbitrator selected in accordance with the AAA's procedures. The arbitrator's decision shall be final and binding on both parties and may be entered as a judgment in any court of competent jurisdiction.

8.2 Contractor hereby waives any right to participate in a class action, collective action, or representative action against Client, and agrees that any arbitration shall be conducted solely on an individual basis.

8.3 Each party shall bear its own costs and attorneys' fees in connection with any arbitration, except that Contractor shall be responsible for all filing fees and administrative costs associated with initiating an arbitration proceeding.

9. TERMINATION

9.1 Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause, upon five (5) calendar days' written notice to Contractor. Upon termination, Client shall have no obligation to pay for any Services not yet completed at the time the termination notice is delivered, nor shall Client owe any cancellation fee, kill fee, minimum commitment, or other termination-related payment of any kind. Contractor shall immediately cease all work and deliver any work in progress to Client upon receipt of a termination notice.

9.2 Contractor may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) calendar days' written notice to Client, provided that Contractor shall complete all work in progress at the time of notice and shall not be relieved of any obligations accrued prior to the effective date of termination.

9.3 Upon termination for any reason, Contractor shall return or destroy all Confidential Information and certify in writing that such return or destruction has been completed.

10. RELATIONSHIP OF THE PARTIES

10.1 Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, agent, or joint venturer of Client. Contractor shall have no authority to bind Client or to create any obligation on behalf of Client.

10.2 Contractor shall be solely responsible for all taxes, insurance, and benefits related to the Services performed under this Agreement.

11. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

11.1 Contractor represents and warrants that (a) Contractor has the right and authority to enter into this Agreement; (b) the Services will be performed in a professional and competent manner; (c) the work product will be original and will not infringe upon or violate the intellectual property rights of any third party; and (d) Contractor will comply with all applicable laws and regulations in the performance of the Services.

12. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

12.1 In no event shall Client be liable to Contractor for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or exemplary damages arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, regardless of the theory of liability. Client's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the amounts actually paid by Client to Contractor in the three (3) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

13. GENERAL PROVISIONS

13.1 Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous agreements, understandings, negotiations, and discussions, whether oral or written.

13.2 Amendments. This Agreement may not be amended or modified except by a written instrument signed by both parties.

13.3 Waiver. The failure of either party to enforce any provision of this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of such provision or the right to enforce it at a later time.

13.4 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

13.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

13.6 Notices. All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed delivered when sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, or by nationally recognized overnight courier to the addresses set forth in the signature block below.

13.7 Assignment. Contractor may not assign or transfer this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of Client. Client may freely assign this Agreement to any successor or affiliate.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
